alt_text: Nine panels show seed 202 at equal starting learning rates 0.3, 1.2 and 1.8. The rows display saved regularized training loss, full-weight update norm, and realized learning rate for fixed, scheduled decay, stagnation decay, and recurrence decay. Policy lines differ by both color and dash pattern. Vertical lines mark actual recorded interventions. At rates 1.8, scheduled and stagnation decay sharply reduce loss and motion; recurrence exactly overlaps fixed because it never triggers. These examples were selected after the run from finite cases and do not summarize all outcomes.
claim_scope_exclusions: No verified neural cycle or shrimp geometry claim.
No statistical generalization beyond these finite pilot tasks.

aggregation_and_transformation: Post-run illustrative rule: seed 202, first three manifest-order rate pairs for which all four policies remained finite. Selected pairs are (0.3,0.3), (1.2,1.2), (1.8,1.8).
Plot all 1200 saved pre-update regularized losses and learning rates; derive full-weight L2 update norms from successive saved states.
Selected pairs retain equal hidden/output realized rates; plot this common rate after asserting exact equality.
Vertical intervention markers use exact recorded event steps.
Common y-axis limits within each quantity row, derived from all selected trajectories.
No smoothing, downsampling, averaging, benchmark claim, or new training.
data_source.exclusions: Illustrative figure omits the other 84 trials; the census figure retains all finite and divergent cases. Selection uses post-run finiteness and cannot support an aggregate success claim.
